advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Thread `cfg.repo_path` (and completion's repo_root) into `resolve_model_string(..., repo_root=...)` so model-class discovery honors the gate's configured root, and add a test that does NOT monkeypatch `_read_llm_file_table`.
evidence: plan_review/__init__.py:83 `return max_output_cfg(replace(cfg, model=resolve_model_string(STANDARD_CLASS)))` — `cfg.repo_path` is available on the received `cfg` but is not passed
model_classes.py:242 `return resolve_class(value, load_class_slots(repo_root))` with `repo_root` defaulting to None -> `_read_llm_file_table(None)` -> `read_reserved_section('llm', None)`
_config_sources.py:135 `_discover_project_config(root=None)` resolves via `repo_root(root)` which falls back to REBAR_ROOT/git-toplevel/cwd (_config_sources.py:30-51), independent of cfg.repo_path
config.py:45-54 the gate's active code root is a ContextVar and `LLMConfig.repo_path` (config.py:532) points at the pinned snapshot in attested mode
resolve_model_string accepts a `repo_root` param (model_classes.py:219) that these callers leave unused
advisory.finding: The verifier paths call `resolve_model_string(STANDARD_CLASS)` without threading `cfg.repo_path`/repo_root, so model-class config is discovered from REBAR_ROOT/git-toplevel/cwd rather than the gate's configured (attested-snapshot) repo root — operator `model_classes` config in the gate repo/snapshot may be read from the wrong root (or not at all).
scenarios: A gate run under an attested snapshot (or any invocation where cwd/REBAR_ROOT != cfg.repo_path) with a repo-local [tool.rebar.llm.model_classes] table configuring the `standard` class — the verifier resolves the built-in default instead of the operator's configured class.
advisory.suggested_fix: Pass the repo root explicitly: in `_verifier_cfg`, `resolve_model_string(STANDARD_CLASS, repo_root=cfg.repo_path)`; give `_verifier_model_for_completion` a repo_root parameter supplied by `_verify_completion_inner` from `config.repo_path` and forward it.

Documented public contract still promises the OLD behavior: docs/plan-review-gate.md:170-171 `the decisive non-frontier VERIFIER_DEFAULT_MODEL ... **unless the operator explicitly chose a model** (REBAR_LLM_MODEL / [tool.rebar.llm].model set to a non-default)` — not updated in this diff.
docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md:155-160 and docs/llm-framework.md:511 (`An explicit non-default REBAR_LLM_MODEL still wins`) also still document the override — none updated.

Consumer/deployment that breaks: any config setting REBAR_LLM_MODEL to a custom verifier model (e.g. an operator pinning the plan-review/completion verifier to a non-default model) — that model is now silently ignored.
advisory.finding: The verifier config/env override contract is removed unversioned: an operator who set `REBAR_LLM_MODEL` / `[tool.rebar.llm].model` to a non-default model previously steered the Pass-2 verify, Pass-4 coach, and completion verifier (the override 'won'); the new code ignores `cfg.model` entirely and always resolves the `standard` class, so this documented public config behavior silently changes with no migration path.
scenarios: An operator with `[tool.rebar.llm].model = <custom-verifier-model>` finds the Pass-2/Pass-4/completion verifier no longer runs on their chosen model after upgrade.
A deployment relying on REBAR_LLM_MODEL to raise the verifier to a stronger model silently loses that override.
